algorithm.selection: git ls-files -co --exclude-standard -z; deduplicate; exclude docs/**; bytewise path sort
algorithm.digest: SHA-256 over each sorted raw path byte string, one NUL byte, then payload; concatenated without extra separators
algorithm.payload: Regular file: exact original bytes; symlink: link target string as filesystem bytes without following; deleted path: hex 005a4b5f44454c4554454400 (NUL ZK_DELETED NUL)
algorithm.metadata: Metadata manifest saved outside repository; no ignored user .env/database is read. Repository env configuration examples and the public bootstrap demo database are source inputs.
